stem.text: A student uses a diffraction grating to determine the wavelength of visible light from a source.

The diffraction grating has $300$ lines per mm. The student measures the angle $\theta$ of each order $n$ of the intensity maxima. A graph of $n$ against $\sin\theta$ is plotted. The line of best fit for the plotted points is shown and has gradient $G$.

stem.alt: Graph of n against sin θ with the axes labelled n and sin θ, the origin marked 0, and a straight line drawn from the origin.

stem.text: Which expression represents the wavelength, in m, of the visible light in terms of $G$?
